info.title: Gen-AI HTTP API
info.description: HTTP API for chat sessions, items, and SSE messages.

get.description: Conversations belonging to the current user in this workspace.

patch.description: Only the title and the pinned flag can be changed.

post.description: Derives a title for the conversation from the messages exchanged so far.

422.description: Title cannot be generated yet or LLM is not configured.

post.description: Changes the active agent on an existing conversation.

403.description: User has no access to target agent.

404.description: Conversation or target agent not found, or feature flag off.

422.description: Cannot switch in a preview conversation.

get.description: Items in the order the agent produced them: text, visualizations, dashboards.

post.description: Streams the agent's reply back over SSE; see the 200 response for the event sequence.

200.description: SSE stream with response_started/item/response_ended events; when interaction intelligence is enabled, interaction_step events (payload {"step": ...}) stream alongside the items.

400.description: Call context is missing organization or user.

403.description: Organization is not entitled to the AI module.

patch.description: Attaches positive or negative feedback, with optional free-text, to one response.
Re-points the conversation's visualization at the metadata object the user saved.
Re-points the conversation's dashboard at the metadata object the user saved.

404.description: Conversation or dashboard not found, or the dashboard builder feature is disabled.

get.description:
List agents the user can use in this workspace, sorted A-Z.

This is the personalized "usable here" view for the agent switcher --
access-filtered to the user, enabled, non-preview, with per-agent
lastUsedAt. For agent CRUD/management use the metadata entity endpoint
GET /api/v1/entities/agents instead.

post.description: Note: This API is an experimental and is going to change. Please, use it accordingly. Generates a natural-language summary of a dashboard's visualizations, optionally scoped by an explicit filter context.

get.description: Returns AI usage stats for the user's organization for the current calendar month, alongside the previous month's value. Backed by the ai_usage_counters table populated by the metering pipeline.

AlertExecution.title: AlertExecution
AlertExecution.description:
Execution definition (AFM) of the alert.

``measures`` / ``attributes`` / ``filters`` are opaque AFM wire objects (same
treatment as ``KeyDriverAnalysis.filters``); the semantic typing the FE renders
lives on the typed ``condition`` union.

dashboard.description: Dashboard the alert is bound to.

forMode.title: Formode
forMode.description: Display mode for the monitored population.

AlertProposal.title: AlertProposal
AlertProposal.description:
Structured pre-creation alert proposal — the single model used as the HTTP DTO,
the persisted shape, and the in-memory conversation-state object.

alertProposal.description: Optional full alert proposal payload when available.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Cron expression for the alert schedule.

dataset.description: Date dataset used for anomaly detection.

AnomalyDetectionGranularity.title: AnomalyDetectionGranularity
AnomalyDetectionGranularity.description: Time-based granularity supported by anomaly detection.

score.title: Score
score.description: Relevance score the retrieval ranked this item by. Null for ALWAYS items, which are not ranked.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: How the item was selected: ALWAYS is injected unconditionally, AUTO by relevance.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of the injected memory item.

AppliedMemoryItem.title: AppliedMemoryItem
AppliedMemoryItem.description: One memory item the turn injected, and how it got there.

durationMs.title: Durationms
durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the memory retrieval. Not part of the turn total, which sums interaction steps, and null on a body stored before this was recorded.

items.title: Items

ApplyMemoryDetail.title: ApplyMemoryDetail
ApplyMemoryDetail.description: Which memory items this turn injected, in the order the retrieval returned them.

operator.description: Arithmetic operator between the two metrics.

ArithmeticOperator.title: ArithmeticOperator
ArithmeticOperator.description: Arithmetic operator between two metrics of a relative condition.

found.title: Found
found.description: Titles the search returned, grouped by object type.

query.title: Query
query.description: Keywords the search looked for. Each runs against every requested type.

requestedTypes.title: Requestedtypes
requestedTypes.description: Catalog types the search asked for.

used.title: Used

CatalogSearchDetail.title: CatalogSearchDetail
CatalogSearchDetail.description: What one search looked for in the semantic catalog, what came back, and what it used.

objectType.title: Objecttype
objectType.description: Catalog type the object is the best match of.

CatalogSearchMatch.title: CatalogSearchMatch

right.title: Right

output.title: Output
output.description: What the turn produced, named by the richest part of its answer.

suggestedActions.title: Suggestedactions
suggestedActions.description: Follow-up actions the answer offered, null when it carried no suggestions.

ComposeAnswerDetail.title: ComposeAnswerDetail
ComposeAnswerDetail.description: How the answer itself came out: what it is and which model wrote it.

actorUserId.title: Actoruserid
actorUserId.description: User who initiated the switch (marker rows only). NULL for drift-driven markers.

agentId.title: Agentid
agentId.description: Agent that processed this item. Populated on every persisted item once LX-2483 ships.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What this item's action did, when its category has a card body; null otherwise, and null on the live stream of non-preview conversations — the trace panel is a preview surface. Replayed items keep it.

itemIndex.title: Itemindex
itemIndex.description: Zero-based item order within the response turn.

newAgentId.title: Newagentid
newAgentId.description: Agent ID after the switch (marker rows only).

oldAgentId.title: Oldagentid
oldAgentId.description: Agent ID before the switch (marker rows only).

reasoningEffort.description: Effort this message was sent with. Set only on user items that carried one; null everywhere else, meaning the turn ran at the MEDIUM default.

stepId.title: Stepid
stepId.description: Interaction step this item belongs to. Null alongside detail on non-preview streams; replayed items keep it.

taskId.title: Taskid
taskId.description: Task identifier grouping related work items.

trigger.title: Trigger

ConversationItemResponse.title: ConversationItemResponse
ConversationItemResponse.description: Conversation item returned by the agentic HTTP API.

ConversationMode.title: ConversationMode
ConversationMode.description:
What a conversation exists to serve.

USER is a person's own thread in the assistant. The others are utility modes, where the
conversation serves something else and is kept out of the user's history: PREVIEW backs
the Agent Builder preview pane, MCP backs a single-purpose MCP tool call.

agentId.title: Agentid
agentId.description: Identifier of the agent bound to this conversation (if any).

isPreview.title: Ispreview
isPreview.description: Deprecated, use `mode`. True only when `mode` is PREVIEW.

mode.description: What this conversation serves. USER is the user's own thread; PREVIEW backs the Agent Builder preview pane; MCP backs a single-purpose MCP tool call. Anything other than USER is a utility conversation, kept out of the user's history.

pinned.title: Pinned
pinned.description: Whether this conversation is pinned by the user.

ConversationResponse.title: ConversationResponse
ConversationResponse.description: Conversation returned by the agentic HTTP API.

mode.description:
What this conversation serves. Omit for USER — a person's own thread in the assistant. PREVIEW backs the Agent Builder preview pane; MCP backs a single-purpose MCP tool call. Anything other than USER is a utility conversation: it is persisted (so follow-up turns can continue it) but kept out of the user's conversation list and out of per-agent last-activity, and it cannot switch agent.

Mutually exclusive with the deprecated isPreview query parameter.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description:
AAC ref: dashboard.json (PoC subset).

The dashboard builder always emits the tabbed layout (``tabs``); ``sections``
is kept for compatibility with the AAC schema's flat (single-layout) form.

references.description: AAC bodies of every widget-referenced visualization, when available.

saved_dashboard_id.title: Saved Dashboard Id
saved_dashboard_id.description: Id of the persisted analyticalDashboard once the user has saved this draft; null while it is still an unsaved draft. Lets the client distinguish a saved dashboard from a draft (e.g. after reload) and update it in place on further edits.

visualizations.title: Visualizations
visualizations.description: Full AAC body of every widget-referenced visualization that has one available.

DashboardReferences.title: DashboardReferences
DashboardReferences.description:
AAC bodies of every widget-referenced visualization in a dashboard draft.

Each entry is opaque AAC pass-through (dict), not modeled as a schema — same
treatment the codebase gives elsewhere to full AAC visualization bodies.

DashboardTab.title: DashboardTab
DashboardTab.description:
AAC ref: dashboard.json tab (the latest, tabbed dashboard layout).

In the tabbed layout filters live on the tab, not on the dashboard root
(the convertor treats tab-level and root-level filters as mutually exclusive).

DashboardWidget.title: DashboardWidget
DashboardWidget.description: AAC ref: dashboard.json visualization widget (size hints in 12-column grid units).

ObservabilityMetricType.description: Metrics exposed by the AI observability endpoint.

titles.title: Titles

SearchedGroup.description: The results of a search that share one object type.

pinnedSkills.title: Pinnedskills
pinnedSkills.description:
Fix this turn's active skills instead of letting the agent route to them. The named skills are activated before the agent loop starts and the set_skills tool is withheld, so the agent cannot route away or pull in another skill. Intended for single-purpose programmatic callers that need a predictable result shape (e.g. the MCP create_visualization tool).

Narrowing-only: the list is intersected with the skills already available in this workspace — those enabled by the organization's feature flags and by the answering agent's own skill configuration. It can never activate a skill that is otherwise unavailable. If none of the requested skills is available the request fails with 400 rather than silently falling back to normal routing.

Omit for normal conversations.

reasoningEffort.description:
How much effort the LLM should spend reasoning about this single message. Applies to this message only; every other message falls back to MEDIUM. Stored on the resulting user item and returned as its reasoningEffort. Behind a feature flag: when disabled, any value here is ignored and MEDIUM is used.

Supported uniformly by all providers (OpenAI, Azure Foundry, Anthropic, Bedrock). On Anthropic/Bedrock models with adaptive thinking, the value is passed as a hint (output_config.effort) rather than a hard token budget.

SkillResponse.title: SkillResponse
SkillResponse.description: A single skill available to the organization.

activated.title: Activated
activated.description: Titles of the skills active after the call replaced the active set.

available.title: Available
available.description: Titles of the skills the model could choose from, in the order the prompt lists them.

SkillRoutingDetail.title: SkillRoutingDetail
SkillRoutingDetail.description: Which skills the turn could reach for, and which this call left active.

StepTokens.title: StepTokens
StepTokens.description: What the step's LLM call spent; a field is null when the provider did not report it.

query.title: Query
query.description: Exact message sent when the user clicks this action.

SuggestedAction.title: SuggestedAction
SuggestedAction.description: A quick-reply action button rendered alongside the follow-up question.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Quick-reply action buttons. The first action matches the follow-up question.

followUpQuestion.title: Followupquestion
followUpQuestion.description: Yes-answerable follow-up question recommending the next step.

Suggestions.title: Suggestions
Suggestions.description:
Follow-up suggestions emitted by the assistant alongside its terminal multipart message.

Carried on the assistant ``MultipartContent`` so suggestions are persisted in
conversation history and stream on the same SSE event as the response that
produced them.

filterContext.title: Filtercontext
filterContext.description: AFM filters in the same shape consumed by the AFM execute endpoint, merged on top of each visualization's stored filters using the type-aware merge rules. Omit or send `null` to fall back to the dashboard's saved filter context. Send `[]` to explicitly apply no request filters.

tabId.title: TabId
tabId.description: Local identifier of the dashboard tab to summarize. When the dashboard has tabs and `tabId` is omitted, the first tab is used (matching the UI's default tab). A `tabId` that does not match any tab's `localIdentifier` returns 404. Supplying `tabId` for a dashboard without tabs returns 400. When `tabId` is combined with `visualizations`, every supplied visualization must belong to the selected tab; otherwise the request returns 400.

activeTabId.title: Activetabid
activeTabId.description: Id of the dashboard tab the user is currently on. Matches the `id` of one entry in `definition.tabs`, which a version-3 dashboard document carries; it is not the `localIdentifier` that the dashboard-summary endpoint's `tabId` matches. Sent for a tab-based dashboard so the assistant can reason about the tab in view instead of assuming the first one. Optional.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: Full layout definition of the open dashboard.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value of the alert threshold to compare the metric to.

visualization.description: Optional full visualization payload (AAC JSON) when available.

whatIf.description: Optional full what-if scenario payload when available.

visualizationRef.title: Visualizationref
visualizationRef.description: Base visualization reference used by scenario.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Chat with an AI Assistant agent. A conversation holds the message history for one workspace and user; sending a message streams the agent's reply back over SSE as a sequence of items (text, visualizations, dashboards) that these endpoints then read back, rate, or link to saved metadata objects.
